cohort: The study utilized cultured umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (UC-MSCs).
finding: Platelet-derived microparticles (PMPs) significantly shortened the population doubling time (PDT) of UC-MSCs, up-regulated hTERT and c-MYC gene expression, and down-regulated p16, p21, and p53 gene expression, suggesting they prolong UC-MSC lifespan.
